<!--
House card: flat nine-section card, as set out on 2026-09-23. The typed
templates refine the middle of it by card type; use one of them when it fits.
There is deliberately no effort or estimate section; sizing belongs to Scope
(and to Blast radius for a Bug). Write in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical
English.
Labels: add exactly one type:*, keep one priority:* and one status:*, and add
one area:*. Assign the GitHub Milestone that owns this work.
Acceptance Criteria and Definition of Done are different: the first is what
the result must satisfy, the second is the signal to stop, usually including
recording the result. Write "none" or "not applicable, because X" instead of
padding a section. Stakeholders names people where the record supports a
name, and says why each cares.
-->

## 1. Background Context
What this concerns.

## 2. Problem Description
What is broken or missing.

## 3. Proposed Solution
How to fix it.

## 4. Prerequisites
Before we start, these must be true.
- [ ]

## 5. Scope
In:
Out:

## 6. Acceptance Criteria
What must be true before this is considered finished.

## 7. Definition of Done
How to know when to stop.

## 8. Test Plan
Golden:
Edges:
Known failure modes:
Fuzz and stress:

## 9. Stakeholders
Named people or teams who care about this issue, and why.
